Doktorica Sanja je pravi primjer stručnosti, nježnosti i posvećenosti.  Prije svega, veliki je čovjek i zaista posebna osoba. Za vrlo kratko vrijeme shvatila sam koliko je posvećena svom poslu i svojim pacijentima.

Kada je moj sin dobio upalu zuba, zahvaljujući njenom stručnom i pravovremenom pristupu sve je prošlo kako treba. Ko zna kako bi naš odmor tekao da nismo naišli na prave ljude.

Sve pohvale za profesionalnost, toplinu i divan odnos prema pacijentu. Kod doktorice Sanje se zaista osjećate sigurno i opušteno. Hvala joj od srca i sve preporuke!  Šalje Vam Vaš Aleksa najveći zagrljaj. ❤️🦷

Sve pohvale za doktorku Sanju!
Prijatna i profesionalna, pomogla nam je da uzivamo u letovanju.
Preporuke od srca za ordinaciju!

Далеко не в каждой клинике стоматолог берётся посмотреть малышей. А в этой клинике врач подточила и поставила пломбу на зубик моей годовалой дочки, а также обработала составом с защитой от кариеса.
Внутри несколько кабинетов, приемная зона и туалет. Чисто.
У входа есть пандус и парковка.
Бутылка для воды в кулере была пустая.
Ljubaznost, stručnost, kvalitet... Sve na jednom mjestu
Don't go here.

I brought my partner to the A&E department as he was having vomiting and diarrhoea, possibly due to food poisoning/gastroenteritis. We initially went to Kotor general hospital and was redirected by a doctor standing outside to this medical centre’s ED.
We were the only ones there and was seen immediately. He was given IV fluid and pain relief and anti emetics through the infusion. The whole process took less than 1 hour. The team spoke English well and communication was good in terms of follow-up plan. Although reviews said that some members of the team might seem dismissive especially when they speak in their own language, the doctors and nurses still treat patients as per any human being. We are very grateful, especially considering the late night circumstances 🙏🏻

Worst medical centre I’ve ever seen, waited half hour before 7am opening time and when they opened the staff were 30 minutes late to start treating patients as they were smoking cigarettes busy in the break room with the lobby full of people waiting confused. I was the first person at the centre yet I got got treatment last as they gave preference to all Serbian speaking people first. Then when I did get my turn after 4 people the nurse said it could take up to 2 hours to get simple iv drop for dehydration as she would need a doctor to administer it as she can’t and it would take upto 2 hours. The staff and the way they treat people is disgusting.

wouldn’t go back there even if I was dying
its hell💀
